'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Dan Tartaglione DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dan Tartaglione]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Dude Playin' A Dude
* '''Username:''' DTartagOne
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
